name: hzdb_run
description:
Invoke any hzdb (Meta's Quest dev CLI) subcommand that isn't exposed as a dedicated MCP tool. hzdb is the standard CLI for Meta Quest VR/MR headset dev — like `gcloud` for GCP.

Prefer a DEDICATED tool when one fits — they have richer schemas: hzdb_app (apps), hzdb_device (devices), hzdb_files (files), meta_docs_search / meta_docs_get_page (docs), get_device_logcat (logs), take_screenshot (screenshots).

Use this catch-all for everything else: `perf` (capture / analyze / simpleperf), `ovrmetrics`, UI automation, audio control, casting, window mgmt, Unity editors, sideload, asset search, config, etc. The `subcommand` enum lists every reachable subcommand path; pass it as an array of segments (e.g. ["perf","capture"]) along with an `args` object keyed by long-flag name. For per-subcommand argument help, call hzdb_cli_help (topic=<group>).

args.description: Arguments for the chosen subcommand, keyed by long-flag name (or arg id for positionals). Boolean flags use true/false; repeatable flags (clap `Append`) use arrays. Validated by hzdb's CLI parser at invocation time.

format.description: Output format passed to hzdb as --format.

subcommand.description: Subcommand path as an array of segments (e.g. ["perf","capture"]). Must be one of the listed paths. Call `hzdb_cli_help` for per-subcommand argument help.
